subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the single canonical tracker for both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue before the sanitizer PR lands?
rationale: The remaining work crosses provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and proof requirements, and automation should not decide whether one broad user-facing crash report should close on a partial fix.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until both the sanitizer path and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path have live proof or an explicit maintainer override.

options.title: Split Auth-Stack Follow-Up
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused canonical follow-up, then allow this issue to close only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Accept Sanitizer Scope Only
options.body: A provider owner can accept the sanitizer PR as sufficient for this issue while preserving the separate ADC evidence somewhere durable.

recommendation.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until both the sanitizer path and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path have live proof or an explicit maintainer override.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the shared Google thinking helper history and is the best available owner for the cross-cutting close/split decision.
